quotes.author: Parisa R
quotes.text: We had a beautiful day of boating. The boat was great, the shade was crucial. My first time driving a boat and I felt really comfortable after a quick orientation. 5 big stars for all the staff. Friendly, and helpful. 4 stars in total just because we had to wait at boat launch in the hot sun for a while till the boat was ready. But otherwise really happy with the service. I believe the price is comparable to most places. Would def rent again, especially for the convenience of the calmer, West side boat launch.

quotes.author: Karen
quotes.text: Had a great day on the lake! Rented a pontoon boat and tube. Being an inexperienced boater the guidance and instruction were much appreciated. Awesome people and I would recommend renting from here to anyone! Thanks for an amazing day on the water🙂

quotes.author: Alys Uren
quotes.text: We hired a JetSki for a couple of hours and absolutely loved it! The ski was fast and in great condition. Staff were super friendly and helpful to teach us how to operate the ski. Instructions were clear, it was a great afternoon on the lake!

quotes.author: melody hoefler
quotes.text: Marty and his team are amazing !!!! We had an amazing time on the lake with his seadoos !
